Title: Public preview: Intra-account container copy for Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Intra-account container copy jobs in Azure Cosmos DB SQL and Cassandra API accounts allow you to create offline copies of containers within your account. With this functionality, you no longer have to worry about figuring out the right tool, setting it up, or configuring it correctly in order to take copies of your data. This ease-of-use functionality can help you while you are trying to do some quick debugging on a copy of your data. It can also speed up your workload optimization process by allowing you to copy the data to a container with the right configurations.

Learn more.
